The main takeaway from our work is that
the introduction of committed agents is a simple way to generate predictions that are not vulnerable to the criticism of the standard imitative models.

the presence of committed agents in a population may have a significant effect on the dynamics of stochastic evolution in games, and may even change the asymptotic behavior of the stationary distribution.
